io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Right now we have 3 live LinkedIn profile APIs that we trust: Up2Data, HarvestAPI and Fetchin. The first time, your client signs you in with your Datacircle email (OAuth). Or send your API key as a Bearer token.
